QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Starling's Proposal
QuestInfo.1: Starling asked you to join her, but didn't tell you the details. #eBastille#n in #bEdelstein#k will go over the details if you visit him.
QuestInfo.2: You met #bBastille#k in Edelstein, but he seemed rather ordinary, if a bit familiar. What kind of work could this man give you?
QuestInfo.0: #p9073000# says that she has something to tell you. She's been acting suspicious from the start... What is she planning?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] Silent Crusade quest

0.0: How would you like to help protect the peace of Maple World?\r\n#L0##bEr... HUH?!#l\n#k
0.1: You probably don't understand what I'm talking about, but we've been watching you, and we want you to work with us. Don't worry about the details for now; you can learn all that later. Here's the important part: Are you interested in using your talent to protect the world?

yes.0: Excellent. Find #bBastille#k in Edelstein. He'll fill you in. He's the dapper fellow with the puppy. Don't make me regret this!

no.0: Don't pretend you don't care about Maple World. Think it over.

npc.0: Talk to Bastille in Edelstein. Look for a dapper gentleman with a black puppy.
